title: /kb-sprint close removes the sprint's worktrees and work branches
goal: The /kb-sprint close step removes, after the close commit is pushed, each subagent worktree under .claude/worktrees and each local work/<id> branch of the sprint's items whose commits are on origin/main (git worktree remove, git branch -d, never -D or --force), and reports any it kept and why; the skill names the commands. Answers the SP-fkyrld5h failure: leftover sprint worktrees made test_research_merge fail in the full tests.py (BG-rrht7uts) and dozens of stale worktree and work branches from past sprints remain in the clone.
